protocol.title: App control protocol / curl examples
protocol.intro: OpenDGLab-OpenProtocol is served over the <0>Connect protocol</0> (JSON/binary, gRPC / gRPC-Web compatible). Every call is a single <1>POST</1> request, where 1 request = 1 event (<2>DGRequest</2>).
protocol.auth: Auth: attach the token obtained from CONNECT in the <0>X-DGLab-Token</0> header
protocol.enumNote: enum (event / deviceChannel) is specified as a name string (e.g. "SETSTRENGTH", "CHANNEL_A")
protocol.section1Desc: Issues a token. Attach it to subsequent requests.
protocol.section2Desc: Gets the deviceId of the target device.
protocol.section3Desc: strengthA/B are absolute values. They are capped by the hub's soft limit.
protocol.section5Desc: deviceChannel is CHANNEL_A / CHANNEL_B. waveName is a name from the list.
protocol.protoDesc: The full definition of messages / enums / services.
